## What's new

### Releases move to github.com/larvyn/larvyn
Now that the source is public, releases, bug reports and Discussions live next to the code in [larvyn/larvyn](https://github.com/larvyn/larvyn). From this version on, Larvyn checks for updates there, and **Report a bug** and **Discussions** open there too.

Nothing to do on your side: older versions still update from [larvyn/releases](https://github.com/larvyn/releases), which gets a copy of each release for now, and the install commands stay the same.
